release_name: Match the diocese site: Sainte-Anne, Saint-Sacrement, Saint-Esprit, 11 coordinates
notes: Follows the diocesan pages more closely, plus more coordinates. (1) Sainte-Anne (Stanley): the page says the exposition runs 07h00 a 18h; five rows previously held 15:30, a time that appears nowhere on the page. Moved to the 07:00 start with the range recorded. (2) Saint-Sacrement (Cassis): added the Tuesday and Thursday 06h30 Celebration the page lists but the data lacked, as Non-Mass other-celebration rows. (3) Centre Chapelle Saint-Esprit now cites its own diocesan page (Saint-Esprit, Cite Briquetterie), where its Saturday 17h00 Mass is the only entry, rather than the generic index; both that page and Sainte-Croix list the same Mass and both are Port-Louis, so this is the more specific of two correct choices. No site now cites the generic index. (4) Notre-Dame-du-Grand-Pouvoir (Cap Malheureux) checked against the diocese: its own page places it at Cap Malheureux with the Mass echoed on Saint-Michel Grand-Gaube, both far north, confirming the regions in our data and confirming the rejected Google result 33 km inland was wrong. Its existing Second Wednesday only rule and confirm advisory already match the page exactly. (5) Eleven more sites moved from locality_level to exact_site_approx. The acceptance gate was CORRECTED mid-run: it originally measured against our own stored coordinate, which wrongly rejected Saint-Nathanael and Saint-Jean-Marie-Vianney - both were right and our stored coordinate was up to 7 km out. The gate now measures from the geocoded town centre and still requires Google to resolve a real named place; that pair of checks rejected a Sainte-Jeanne-d Arc result that was in PARIS, 9727 km away. 34 sites remain at locality level.
